svg.title: tsrs vs TypeScript 7.1 nightly
svg.desc: How many times faster tsrs type-checks than tsgo (TypeScript 7.1 nightly), against how many times less peak memory it uses, both compilers at --checkers 1, 2, 4 and 8 on an 8-vCPU Linux machine. Up and to the right is better. vscode: --checkers 1: 2.1x faster, 2.9x less memory (tsgo 26.79 s, 4.59 GiB; tsrs 12.73 s, 1.59 GiB); --checkers 2: 2.3x faster, 2.9x less memory (tsgo 15.33 s, 4.92 GiB; tsrs 6.70 s, 1.68 GiB); --checkers 4: 2.7x faster, 3.0x less memory (tsgo 10.02 s, 5.27 GiB; tsrs 3.67 s, 1.76 GiB); --checkers 8: 3.3x faster, 3.1x less memory (tsgo 7.48 s, 5.92 GiB; tsrs 2.27 s, 1.89 GiB). mui-docs: --checkers 1: 2.8x faster, 2.8x less memory (tsgo 10.72 s, 2.06 GiB; tsrs 3.82 s, 0.75 GiB); --checkers 2: 3.4x faster, 2.9x less memory (tsgo 8.20 s, 2.50 GiB; tsrs 2.45 s, 0.86 GiB); --checkers 4: 3.5x faster, 3.1x less memory (tsgo 6.27 s, 3.12 GiB; tsrs 1.77 s, 1.02 GiB); --checkers 8: 4.3x faster, 3.5x less memory (tsgo 6.73 s, 4.46 GiB; tsrs 1.56 s, 1.28 GiB). t3code-server: --checkers 1: 3.2x faster, 3.3x less memory (tsgo 18.15 s, 2.45 GiB; tsrs 5.60 s, 0.74 GiB); --checkers 2: 4.0x faster, 3.1x less memory (tsgo 15.18 s, 2.85 GiB; tsrs 3.75 s, 0.92 GiB); --checkers 4: 4.7x faster, 3.7x less memory (tsgo 12.18 s, 4.23 GiB; tsrs 2.57 s, 1.15 GiB); --checkers 8: 5.0x faster, 3.7x less memory (tsgo 12.34 s, 5.50 GiB; tsrs 2.48 s, 1.51 GiB). supabase: --checkers 1: 2.6x faster, 2.6x less memory (tsgo 13.10 s, 2.27 GiB; tsrs 5.07 s, 0.88 GiB); --checkers 2: 3.3x faster, 2.5x less memory (tsgo 10.92 s, 2.52 GiB; tsrs 3.30 s, 1.03 GiB); --checkers 4: 3.4x faster, 2.7x less memory (tsgo 6.83 s, 3.08 GiB; tsrs 2.00 s, 1.15 GiB); --checkers 8: 3.6x faster, 3.2x less memory (tsgo 5.08 s, 4.30 GiB; tsrs 1.39 s, 1.36 GiB). playwright: --checkers 1: 2.2x faster, 2.3x less memory (tsgo 2.18 s, 0.56 GiB; tsrs 1.01 s, 0.25 GiB); --checkers 2: 2.6x faster, 2.4x less memory (tsgo 1.50 s, 0.62 GiB; tsrs 0.57 s, 0.26 GiB); --checkers 4: 3.1x faster, 2.4x less memory (tsgo 1.19 s, 0.76 GiB; tsrs 0.39 s, 0.31 GiB); --checkers 8: 3.3x faster, 2.7x less memory (tsgo 0.94 s, 0.99 GiB; tsrs 0.28 s, 0.37 GiB). typeorm: --checkers 1: 2.0x faster, 2.0x less memory (tsgo 1.69 s, 0.40 GiB; tsrs 0.83 s, 0.20 GiB); --checkers 2: 2.3x faster, 2.1x less memory (tsgo 1.11 s, 0.42 GiB; tsrs 0.49 s, 0.20 GiB); --checkers 4: 2.5x faster, 2.2x less memory (tsgo 0.78 s, 0.46 GiB; tsrs 0.31 s, 0.21 GiB); --checkers 8: 2.7x faster, 2.2x less memory (tsgo 0.60 s, 0.50 GiB; tsrs 0.22 s, 0.23 GiB). date-fns: --checkers 1: 2.8x faster, 1.9x less memory (tsgo 0.30 s, 0.26 GiB; tsrs 0.11 s, 0.14 GiB); --checkers 2: 2.6x faster, 1.9x less memory (tsgo 0.28 s, 0.26 GiB; tsrs 0.11 s, 0.14 GiB); --checkers 4: 2.7x faster, 1.9x less memory (tsgo 0.29 s, 0.25 GiB; tsrs 0.11 s, 0.14 GiB); --checkers 8: 2.4x faster, 1.8x less memory (tsgo 0.28 s, 0.25 GiB; tsrs 0.11 s, 0.14 GiB). Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses cargo build --release. Machine: local Linux x86_64, pinned to 8 cores with taskset. Measured 2026-10-19 03:38 UTC; tsrs commit 483eedb398443ca4634a68e28044f7da544fc43c. TypeScript 7.1.0-dev.20261018.1; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
